name: invite-people
title: Invite People
description: Invite a teammate by email, validate the address and update the member list.
useCases: In project settings, an admin enters a designer’s email. The app sends the invitation through onInvite and the form keeps the address if delivery fails.
When setting up a team, the organizer checks the existing members before inviting the next colleague.
task: Invite a teammate by email, validate the address and update the member list.

models.ProjectMember: type ProjectMember = { name: string; email: string; avatar?: string };

behavior: Supply existing members in members. onInvite receives a normalized email address. Reject its Promise to keep the address available for retry.
